claim: humanize turns numbers, sizes, durations and fractions into human-readable strings (e.g. 12345 -> '12,345', 1001s -> '17 minutes', 1000000 bytes -> '1.0 MB') and can switch locale at runtime.

files.scratch/core.py:
import datetime as dt
import humanize

delta = dt.timedelta(seconds=3633, days=2, microseconds=123000)
ms = dt.timedelta(milliseconds=4)
cases = [
    ('intcomma', humanize.intcomma(12345), '12,345'),
    ('intword1', humanize.intword(123455913), '123.5 million'),
    ('intword2', humanize.intword(12345591313), '12.3 billion'),
    ('apnumber4', humanize.apnumber(4), 'four'),
    ('apnumber41', humanize.apnumber(41), '41'),
    ('naturaldelta', humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(seconds=1001)), '17 minutes'),
    ('naturalday_today', humanize.naturalday(dt.datetime.now()), 'today'),
    ('naturalday_yest', humanize.naturalday(dt.datetime.now() - dt.timedelta(days=1)), 'yesterday'),
    ('naturaldate', humanize.naturaldate(dt.date(2007, 6, 5)), 'Jun 05 2007'),
    ('naturaltime_hour', humanize.naturaltime(dt.datetime.now() - dt.timedelta(seconds=3600)), 'an hour ago'),
    ('naturaltime_ms', humanize.naturaltime(ms, minimum_unit='milliseconds'), '4 milliseconds ago'),
    ('precisedelta', humanize.precisedelta(delta), '2 days, 1 hour and 33.12 seconds'),
    ('precisedelta_us', humanize.precisedelta(delta, minimum_unit='microseconds'), '2 days, 1 hour, 33 seconds and 123 milliseconds'),
    ('precisedelta_sup', humanize.precisedelta(delta, suppress=['days'], format='%0.4f'), '49 hours and 33.1230 seconds'),
    ('size', humanize.naturalsize(1_000_000), '1.0 MB'),
    ('size_bin', humanize.naturalsize(1_000_000, binary=True), '976.6 KiB'),
    ('size_gnu', humanize.naturalsize(1_000_000, gnu=True), '976.6K'),
    ('frac_third', humanize.fractional(1/3), '1/3'),
    ('frac_15', humanize.fractional(1.5), '1 1/2'),
    ('frac_03', humanize.fractional(0.3), '3/10'),
    ('sci', humanize.scientific(500), '5.00 x 10\u00b2'),
    ('sci_neg', humanize.scientific(0.3), '3.00 x 10\u207b\u00b9'),
    ('list3', humanize.natural_list(['one', 'two', 'three']), 'one, two and three'),
    ('ordinal', humanize.ordinal(103), '103rd'),
]
ok = 0
for name, got, want in cases:
    if got == want:
        ok += 1
    else:
        print('MISMATCH %s got=%r want=%r' % (name, got, want))
print('CORE_PASS=%d/%d' % (ok, len(cases)))
files.scratch/i18n.py:
import datetime as dt
import humanize

en = humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(seconds=3))
print('EN=' + en)
humanize.i18n.activate('ru_RU')
ru = humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(seconds=3))
print('RU=' + ru)
humanize.i18n.deactivate()
humanize.i18n.activate('tr_TR')
tr = humanize.intcomma(1_234_567.89)
print('TR=' + tr)
humanize.i18n.deactivate()
back = humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(seconds=3))
print('BACK_TO_EN=%s' % (back == en))
print('LOCALE_OK=%s' % (ru != en and tr == '1.234.567,89' and back == en))
